We need to correctly call map_reaction_smiles. Let's construct reaction SMILES as described. Use tool map_reaction_smiles.

We need to ensure correct SMILES strings: precursor1: "O=S(Cl)(=O)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1" (sulfonyl chloride). precursor2: "Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2" (aniline). product: "O=S(=O)(C1=CC(F)=CC=C1)Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2". Reaction SMILES: "O=S(Cl)(=O)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1.Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2>>O=S(=O)(C1=CC(F)=CC=C1)Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2"

Now call map_reaction_smiles.
